items.title: OSCAR: an omics atlas of paired single-cell ATAC-seq and RNA-seq for decoding cell-specific gene regulation.
items.title_zh: OSCAR：一个配对单细胞ATAC-seq和RNA-seq的组学图谱，用于解码细胞特异性基因调控。
items.summary_zh: 配对的单细胞染色质可及性和转录组图谱为剖析多种生物过程和人类疾病背后的细胞特异性调控程序提供了强大框架。配对单细胞转座酶可及染色质测序（scATAC-seq）和单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据的快速积累，导致迫切需要全面整合这些数据以阐明单细胞分辨率的调控景观。为满足这一需求，我们开发了OSCAR（配对单细胞ATAC和RNA-seq的组学图谱，https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/），以整理大规模配对scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq数据，并提供全面的调控注释和分析。当前版本的OSCAR收录了来自30种组织类型的1136个样本的7749898个人类细胞。重要的是，OSCAR整合配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq图谱进行联合细胞聚类和峰-基因连锁识别，并为标记峰和标记基因的调控元件提供详细的（表观）遗传注释，包括超级增强子、增强子、增强子RNA

extra.description: Paired single-cell chromatin accessibility and transcriptome profiles provide a powerful framework for dissecting cell-specific regulatory programs underlying diverse biological processes and human diseases. The rapid accumulation of paired single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin sequencing (scATAC-seq) and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data has led to an urgent need to comprehensively integrate these data to illustrate the regulatory landscape at single-cell resolution. To address this need, we developed OSCAR (an Omics atlas of paired Single-Cell ATAC and RNA-seq, https://bio.liclab.net/OSCAR/) to curate large-scale paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq data and to provide comprehensive regulatory annotations and analyses. The current version of OSCAR catalogs 7749 898 human cells from 1136 samples across 30 tissue types. Importantly, OSCAR integrates paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq profiles for joint cell clustering and peak-to-gene linkage identification, and provides detailed (epi)genetic annotations for marker peaks and regulatory elements of marker genes, including super-enhancers, enhancers, enhancer RNAs (eRNAs), common and risk single nucleotide polymorphisms, expression quantitative trait loci, transcription factor binding sites, transcription factor/transcription co-factor binding peaks, Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)/Cas9 target sites, DNase I hypersensitivity sites, chromatin accessibility regions, DNA methylation sites, chromatin interaction regions, and topologically associating domains. Furthermore, OSCAR provides three online analysis tools, including cell type enrichment analysis, sequence-based peak regulatory analysis, and peak-to-gene linkage analysis. Hence, OSCAR is a useful platform to query, browse, analyze, and visualize cell-specific regulatory programs across diverse human tissues and diseases.

items.title: Single-cell landscape of human adipose tissue reveals THBS1 as a potential driver of fibro-inflammation in metabolic disease.
items.title_zh: 人类脂肪组织的单细胞景观揭示THBS1是代谢疾病中纤维炎症的潜在驱动因素。
items.summary_zh: 脂肪组织的细胞复杂性在代谢疾病发病机制中起关键作用；然而，脂肪功能障碍的机制仍知之甚少。在这里，我们构建了来自一个种族同质队列的人类内脏脂肪组织的单核和批量转录组图谱，该队列具有明确的代谢状态：瘦且糖耐量正常、肥胖、肥胖伴2型糖尿病。单核RNA测序（snRNA-seq）揭示了一个以高THBS1表达为特征的脂肪干细胞和脂肪细胞的纤维炎症亚群，与瘦对照组相比，这些细胞在肥胖和肥胖伴2型糖尿病个体中富集。通过互补的体外（人原代ASCs、THP-1巨噬细胞和Matrigel捕获的成熟脂肪细胞）、离体（小鼠和人类内脏脂肪组织外植体）和体内（功能获得和抗体介导的中和）实验，我们证明THBS1通过巨噬细胞介导的TGFβ激活促进脂肪纤维化和炎症，损害脂肪生成和脂肪细胞功能。抑制THBS1减轻代谢功能障碍脂肪组织中的纤维炎症特征。此外，血浆和脂肪细胞中的THBS1水平与代谢特征相关，包括BMI和HbA1c。

extra.description: The cellular complexity of adipose tissue plays a critical role in the pathogenesis of metabolic disease; however, mechanisms underlying adipose dysfunction remain poorly understood. Here, we constructed a single-nucleus and bulk transcriptomic atlas of human visceral adipose tissues from an ethnically homogeneous cohort with defined metabolic states: lean with normal glucose tolerance, obesity, and obesity with type 2 diabetes. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) revealed a fibro-inflammatory subpopulation of adipose stem cells and adipocytes characterized by high THBS1 expression, which were enriched in individuals with obesity and obesity with type 2 diabetes compared to lean controls. Through complementary in vitro (human primary ASCs, THP-1 macrophages, and Matrigel-captured mature adipocytes), ex vivo (mouse and human visceral adipose tissue explants), and in vivo (gain-of-function and antibody-mediated neutralization) experiments, we demonstrated that THBS1 promoted adipose fibrosis and inflammation via macrophage-mediated TGFβ activation, impairing adipogenesis and adipocyte function. Inhibition of THBS1 attenuated fibro-inflammatory features in metabolically dysfunctional adipose tissues. Moreover, THBS1 levels in plasma and adipocytes correlated with metabolic traits, including BMI and HbA1c. Collectively, our study provides a cellular atlas of human visceral adipose tissues across metabolic disease states and identifies THBS1 as a key pathogenic driver and potential therapeutic target.

items.title: HRD: an integrated multi-omics resource for human reproduction and development
items.title_zh: HRD：人类生殖与发育的综合多组学资源
items.summary_zh: 摘要 人类生殖与发育是一个由遗传、分子和环境因素塑造的连续过程。然而，相关数据仍分散在公共存储库和文献中，限制了系统整合、分析和再利用。我们开发了人类生殖与发育数据库（HRD；http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/），这是一个综合多组学资源，组织与多个生殖、妊娠和发育背景相关的公开可用数据。HRD 1.0版包含814条组学记录，包括432条批量转录组、144条单细胞或单核转录组、156条表观基因组、52条代谢组和30条蛋白质组记录，以及702条临床试验记录、293条暴露-结局关联和779个带有 curated 表型关联的先导SNP。通过协调关键元数据并应用数据类型特定的分析工作流，HRD将组学数据、遗传关联、暴露-结局证据和临床试验数据纳入一个共同框架，以探索生殖和发育多个阶段的数据。该网站支持关键词搜索、组合筛选、基于类别的浏览、统计摘要和数据下载，并提供差异分析、功能富集

extra.description: Abstract Human reproduction and development span a continuum shaped by genetic, molecular, and environmental factors. However, relevant data remain dispersed across public repositories and the literature, limiting systematic integration, analysis, and reuse. We developed the Human Reproduction and Development Database (HRD; http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/), an integrated multi-omics resource that organizes publicly available data relevant to multiple reproductive, pregnancy, and developmental contexts. HRD version 1.0 contains 814 omics records, including 432 bulk transcriptomic, 144 single-cell or single-nucleus transcriptomic, 156 epigenomic, 52 metabolomic, and 30 proteomic records, together with 702 clinical trial records, 293 exposure-outcome associations, and 779 lead SNPs with curated phenotype associations. By harmonising key metadata and applying data-type-specific analysis workflows, HRD brings omics data, genetic associations, exposure-outcome evidence, and clinical trial data into a common framework for exploring data from multiple stages of reproduction and development. The website supports keyword search, combined filtering, category-based browsing, statistical summaries and data downloads, and provides interactive visualizations of differential analyses, functional enrichment, cell clustering, chromatin accessibility, peak annotation, regulatory networks, and cross-phenotype association plots. HRD supports the retrieval, comparison, and reuse of reproductive and developmental data and analysis results.

items.title: An extensible deep learning framework for multi-type chromatin interaction prediction through hierarchical adaptation strategies
items.title_zh: 一个通过分层适应策略进行多类型染色质相互作用预测的可扩展深度学习框架
items.summary_zh: 三维染色质相互作用在基因调控中起重要作用，然而多种相互作用类型的计算预测在很大程度上仍依赖于专门的单任务模型。在这里，我们提出UniLoopNet，一个多任务深度学习框架，可从DNA序列预测多种类型的染色质相互作用，包括增强子-启动子相互作用、增强子-增强子相互作用、CTCF介导的环和条纹相关相互作用。UniLoopNet采用共享编码器-解码器架构和分层适应策略，基于任务语义相似性整合多任务、迁移和持续学习。跨多个细胞系的全面基准测试表明，UniLoopNet优于现有的专门和多任务方法，大多数任务的AUROC超过0.90。在严格评估设置下，包括染色体匹配、距离匹配、现实不平衡和位点不相交测试，AUROC范围为0.8934至0.9366。在现实的1:5类别不平衡设置中，增强子-启动子和增强子-增强子相互作用预测的AUPRC分别为0.7956和0.6935。跨细胞系迁移实验进一步表明，将Uni

extra.description: Three-dimensional chromatin interactions play essential roles in gene regulation, yet computational prediction of diverse interaction types remains largely dependent on specialized, single-task models. Here, we present UniLoopNet, a multi-task deep learning framework that predicts multiple types of chromatin interactions including enhancer–promoter interactions, enhancer–enhancer interactions, CTCF-mediated loops, and stripe-associated interactions from DNA sequences. UniLoopNet employs a shared encoder–decoder architecture with hierarchical adaptation strategies, integrating multi-task, transfer, and continual learning based on task semantic similarity. Comprehensive benchmarking across multiple cell lines demonstrates that UniLoopNet outperforms existing specialized and multi-task approaches, with AUROCs exceeding 0.90 in most tasks. Under stringent evaluation settings, including chromosome-matched, distance-matched, realistic imbalanced, and locus-disjoint tests, AUROCs range from 0.8934 to 0.9366. In the realistic 1:5 class-imbalance setting, the AUPRCs for enhancer–promoter and enhancer–enhancer interaction prediction are 0.7956 and 0.6935, respectively. Cross-cell-line transfer experiments further show that applying UniLoopNet to another cell line requires adaptation by supervised fine-tuning on target-cell-line data, after which performance is comparable to that of within-cell-line training. Notably, the framework exhibits data efficiency in experiments with substantially reduced training data. Interpretability analyses reveal that the learned sequence features are associated with known transcription factor binding sites and uncover differential regulatory effects of disease-associated variants. UniLoopNet provides a versatile and data-efficient framework for sequence-based prediction and interpretation of diverse 3D genome interactions, complementing existing sequence-to-map approaches while improving the understanding of sequence-encoded regulatory potential.

items.title: CALT-GNN: a graph neural network with cross-attention and long-tail experts for multi-omics cancer subtype classification
items.title_zh: CALT-GNN：一种用于多组学癌症亚型分类的交叉注意力和长尾专家图神经网络
items.summary_zh: 摘要 基于分子特征的癌症亚型分类对于表征肿瘤异质性、评估患者预后和支持精准治疗很重要。多组学整合提供了基因组、表观基因组、转录组和蛋白质组层面的互补分子信息。然而，多组学数据的高维性、复杂的跨组学关系和不平衡的亚型分布仍是主要挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出CALT-GNN，一种图神经网络框架，整合患者相似性图学习、基于交叉注意力的组学整合、长尾专家分类和可学习预测融合。该框架首先构建组学特异性患者相似性图，使用图卷积网络学习潜在患者表示，并通过相似性网络融合获得统一图。交叉注意力分支将CNA和DNA甲基化作为源模态，mRNA表达作为目标模态，建模互补关系。并行地，长尾专家分支使用主要和次要专家，配合原型引导路由，执行类别分布感知分类。两个分支的输出随后使用可学习全局权重组合。在八个TCGA多组学队列上的实验表明，CALT-GNN相对于代表性基线方法取得了有竞争力或可比的分类性能，并在对类别

extra.description: Abstract Cancer subtype classification based on molecular features is important for characterizing tumor heterogeneity, evaluating patient prognosis, and supporting precision treatment. Multi-omics integration provides complementary molecular information across genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels. However, the high dimensionality of multi-omics data, complex cross-omics relationships, and imbalanced subtype distributions remain major challenges. To address these issues, we propose CALT-GNN, a graph neural network framework that integrates patient-similarity graph learning, cross-attention-based omics integration, long-tail expert classification, and learnable prediction fusion. The framework first constructs omics-specific patient-similarity graphs, learns latent patient representations using graph convolutional networks, and obtains a unified graph through similarity network fusion. A cross-attention branch models complementary relationships between CNA and DNA methylation as source modalities and mRNA expression as the target modality. In parallel, a long-tail expert branch uses Major and Minor Experts with prototype-guided routing to perform class-distribution-aware classification. The outputs of the two branches are subsequently combined using a learnable global weight. Experiments on eight TCGA multi-omics cohorts showed that CALT-GNN achieved competitive or comparable classification performance relative to representative baseline methods and stable performance on Macro-F1 and MCC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. Ablation and subtype-level analyses further supported the complementary contributions of cross-omics interaction modeling and adaptive long-tail expert routing, although the magnitude of the improvements varied across cohorts and subtypes. These results suggest that CALT-GNN provides a methodological framework for multi-omics cancer subtype classification under complex cross-omics relationships and imbalanced subtype distributions.

items.title: HGVD: Human Genetic Variation Database update 2026 with sequencing of 4344 genetically diverse Japanese individuals.

extra.description: Population-scale genome resources remain biased toward European ancestry, limiting variant interpretation in underrepresented populations. Here, we expanded the Human Genetic Variation Database (HGVD), a free Japanese allele-frequency resource launched in 2013. HGVD v3.1 integrates 1209 exomes with whole-genome sequencing (WGS) data from 3135 Japanese individuals selected by principal component analysis (PCA) to span genetic diversity, providing aggregate variant statistics for 4344 individuals, 3248 genotyped individuals, and expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) from 300 individuals. For research and clinical use, HGVD provides coordinated JBrowse-based browsers for GRCh37/hg19, GRCh38/hg38, and T2T-CHM13. The non-GRCh37 variant tracks were generated by liftOver from the GRCh37 call set. Variant frequencies, sample counts, and coverage are available across assemblies, whereas eQTL annotations are currently available only on hg19. A downloadable, graph-genome-ready structural-variant release is provided, and the new pathSTR portal reports population-level distributions for 68 medically relevant tandem-repeat loci, derived by applying STRdust to long-read Oxford Nanopore data from 1019 individuals of the 1000 Genomes Project remapped to T2T-CHM13. HGVD v3.1 supports population-matched interpretation of rare pathogenic and pharmacogenomic variants, comparison of repeat-expansion alleles with long-read reference distributions, and structural-variant-aware reference construction, supporting precision medicine for Japan and East Asian populations. HGVD is available at https://www.hgvd.genome.med.kyoto-u.ac.jp/.

items.title: CellMarker 3.0: an updated resource of manually curated and computationally predicted cell markers in human/mouse and interactive web tools for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics analysis.
items.title_zh: CellMarker 3.0：一个更新的资源，包含人工 curated 和计算预测的人类/小鼠细胞标记物，以及用于单细胞和空间转录组学分析的交互式网络工具。

extra.description: The updated CellMarker 3.0 resource (http://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/CellMarker) offers a comprehensive resource, integrating experimentally validated and robustly algorithm-predicted marker genes for diverse cell types across human and mouse tissues. In addition, web tools for analyzing single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics (ST) data are described. CellMarker 3.0 was updated with more data and new features, including (i) appending 274 tissues, 1877 cell types, 64 040 markers, and 1 245 923 tissue-cell type-marker entries over the previous version. The current release contains 930 tissues, 4455 cell types, and 90 955 cell markers, resulting in a total of 1 329 284 tissue-cell type-marker entries. (ii) Expanding the resource to include computationally predicted cell-type markers derived from six algorithms, namely Spapros, Seurat::FindAllMarkers, SEMITONES, Cepo, CelliD, and COSG. (iii) New marker information was incorporated from 168 sequencing technologies, such as CEL-Seq2 and SNARE-seq. (iv) Covering 35 types of cell markers, including protein-coding genes, rRNAs, and pseudogenes. (v) The cell tool module was comprehensively restructured and upgraded, with the original six scRNA-seq analysis modules systematically optimized and two new spatial transcriptomics modules, Spatial Expression, and Spatial Chat, added. CellMarker 3.0 is a valuable resource that integrates cell identity identification, single-cell transcriptomics, and spatial transcriptomics analysis.

items.title: VarNexus: an integrative database for interpreting disease-associated regulatory variants through multimodal predictions and functional evidence.
items.title_zh: VarNexus：一个通过多模态预测和功能证据解释疾病相关调控变异的整合数据库。
items.summary_zh: 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）已识别出许多与复杂疾病和性状相关的位点，但非编码风险变异的功能解释仍然具有挑战性。像AlphaGenome这样的序列到功能模型提供大规模多模态变异效应预测，但其预测缺乏直接实验支持。相比之下，分子数量性状位点（QTLs）和大规模并行报告基因 assay（MPRAs）等经验资源提供基于群体或实验的变异功能支持，但基因组覆盖有限。在这里，我们提出VarNexus（https://biomed.imu.edu.cn/varnexus），一个整合资源，将疾病相关变异与预测、基于群体和实验证据联系起来。VarNexus目前包含来自UK Biobank和FinnGen的1891个疾病相关表型的230404个精细定位候选变异。它整合了跨11种调控输出类型的预计算AlphaGenome预测与批量 and 单细胞xQTLs、MPRA测量和GWAS-eQTL共定位结果。VarNex

extra.description: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified numerous loci associated with complex diseases and traits, yet the functional interpretation of non-coding risk variants remains challenging. Sequence-to-function models like AlphaGenome provide large-scale multi-modal predictions of variant effects, but their predictions lack direct experimental support. In contrast, empirical resources such as molecular quantitative trait loci (QTLs) and massively parallel reporter assays (MPRAs) offer population-based or experimental support for variant function, but suffer from limited genomic coverage. Here, we present VarNexus (https://biomed.imu.edu.cn/varnexus), an integrative resource for connecting disease-associated variants with predicted, population-based, and experimental evidence. VarNexus currently contains 230 404 fine-mapped candidate variants across 1891 disease-related phenotypes from UK Biobank and FinnGen. It integrates precomputed AlphaGenome predictions across 11 regulatory output types with bulk and single-cell xQTLs, MPRA measurements, and GWAS-eQTL colocalization results. VarNexus enables cross-linked searches by variant, phenotype, and gene, together with on-demand AlphaGenome prediction, multi-omics genome-browser visualization, and regulatory network exploration. By combining sequence-based predictions with population-based and experimental evidence, VarNexus provides a framework for prioritizing candidate regulatory mechanisms supported by multiple evidence layers.

items.title: Cell3D: a comprehensive database for interactive 3D visualization and crosstalk analysis of single-cell and spatial omics.
items.title_zh: Cell3D：一个用于单细胞和空间组学交互式3D可视化和串扰分析的综合数据库。
items.summary_zh: 单细胞和空间转录组学产生大规模、高维数据集。然而，跨特征整合探索受到限制，因为大多数当前平台支持单一数据类型，缺乏用于多特征分析的交互式可视化。为解决这一未满足的需求，我们开发了Cell3D，一个可访问且多功能的交互式平台，旨在推进整合多级特征分析。Cell3D整理了898个公开可用数据集，包括397个单细胞和501个空间转录组学数据集，涵盖来自11个物种的105种疾病、756种细胞类型和83个器官/组织中的2924646个单细胞和空间点。该数据库整合了十二个主流功能注释系统，提供了解剖空间和细胞维度分子特征的全面景观。用户可以在多个层面探索数据，从基因表达和细胞簇到通路活动和临床表型。Cell3D提供一套用户友好的功能，包括可定制的2D/3D交互式可视化以进行动态多级特征投影、具有自动识别功能的灵活数据整合、定量串扰分析，以及支持疾病研究和生物标志物发现的微环境聚焦整合分析。总之，Cel

extra.description: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics yield large-scale, high-dimensional datasets. However, cross-feature integrative exploration is constrained, since most current platforms support a single data type and lack interactive visualization for multi-feature analysis. To address this unmet need, we developed Cell3D, an accessible and versatile interactive platform designed to advance integrative multi-level feature analysis. Cell3D curates 898 publicly available datasets, comprising 397 single-cell and 501 spatial transcriptomic datasets, encompassing 2 924 646 single cells and spatial spots across 105 diseases, 756 cell types, and 83 organs/tissues from 11 species. The database integrates twelve mainstream functional annotation systems, providing a comprehensive landscape for dissecting molecular features across spatial and cellular dimensions. Users can explore data at multiple levels, from gene expression and cell clusters to pathway activities and clinical phenotypes. Cell3D offers a suite of user-friendly functionalities, including customizable 2D/3D interactive visualization for dynamic multi-level feature projection, flexible data integration with automatic recognition, quantitative crosstalk analysis, and microenvironment-focused integrative analysis supporting disease research and biomarker discovery. Collectively, Cell3D enables exploration of tissue microenvironments at both cellular and spatial resolutions, bridging molecular perturbations and tissue architecture in health and disease. The database is freely accessible at https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/Cell3D.

items.title: SpatialRegNet: spatially resolved mapping of active regulatory network of human and mouse
items.title_zh: SpatialRegNet：人类和小鼠活跃调控网络的空间分辨映射
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间微环境和细胞功能状态由时空动态基因调控网络（GRN）调控，因此解析它们对于理解疾病发病机制和正常组织程序至关重要。尽管多个空间转录组数据库快速发展，但大多数缺乏对细胞内 GRN 及其空间耦合模式的系统整合。在此，我们提出 SpatialRegNet（https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/SpatialRegNet/），一个综合数据库，整理了来自 152 个人类和小鼠空间转录组数据集的 1322 张组织切片，覆盖 68 种组织类型和 93 种不同疾病或疾病亚型，包含 3,744,216 个空间 spot。该数据库量化了 6733 个转录因子（TF）介导的 regulon 网络的 spot 级活性，这些网络共包含超过 1270 万个 TF–靶基因对，并归档了 802,935 个在不同空间 niche/细胞类型中高度活跃的 regulon 网络。Spatia

extra.description: Abstract The spatial microenvironment and cellular functional states are governed by spatiotemporally dynamic gene regulatory networks (GRNs), making their dissection essential for understanding disease pathogenesis and normal tissue programs. Despite the rapid development of multiple spatial transcriptomics databases, most lack systematic integration of intracellular GRNs and their spatial coupling patterns. Here, we present SpatialRegNet (https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/SpatialRegNet/), a comprehensive database curating 1322 tissue slices derived from 152 human and mouse spatial transcriptomic datasets that span 68 tissue types and 93 distinct diseases or disease subtypes, encompassing 3 744 216 spatial spots. The database quantifies spot-level activity for 6733 transcription factor (TF)-mediated regulon networks, which collectively contain over 12.7 million TF–target gene pairs, and archives 802 935 regulon networks that are highly active in distinct spatial niches/cell types. SpatialRegNet embeds a suite of interactive online tools for analyzing regulon networks in spatial contexts, enabling users to interrogate the correlations between regulon network activity and cellular identities, map spatial regulatory heterogeneity and specificity, track dynamic regulon network activity across cell differentiation trajectories, reconstruct intercellular communication signaling cascades, and generate three-dimensional visualizations of regulon network activity. Collectively, SpatialRegNet constitutes a valuable public resource to advance mechanistic investigations of physiological tissue function, disease etiology, and biomarker discovery in spatially resolved GRNs.

items.title: 4D-atlas: a multi-species four-dimensional spatiotemporal transcriptomics database spanning development, regeneration, and disease

extra.description: Abstract Four-dimensional (4D) spatial transcriptomics, which captures molecular landscapes across both three-dimensional (3D) tissue architecture and temporal progression, is essential for deciphering dynamic biological processes such as development, regeneration, and disease progression. Here, we present 4D-atlas (https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/4D-Atlas or https://4d-atlas.bio-database.com/), the first publicly accessible database dedicated to multi-species 4D spatiotemporal transcriptomic atlases. 4D-atlas collects and standardizes 1629 spatial slices spanning 88 distinct time points with 2–41 per dataset and over 22.2 million cells or spatial spots from 15 representative datasets across six species, encompassing embryonic development, tissue regeneration, and disease progression. Beyond data collection, 4D-atlas provides seven interactive analytical modules that enable 4D (3D space + time) exploration of tissue morphogenesis, spatial gene modules, pathway activities, regulatory networks, cell–cell communication, developmental trajectories, and temporal expression patterns. Using a unified analytical pipeline to integrate 3D spatial architecture and molecular information across discrete biological stages, 4D-atlas enables systematic investigation of tissue morphogenesis and dynamic regulatory programs across time and space.

items.title: scSpatial: an atlas for single-cell spatial omics
items.title_zh: scSpatial：单细胞空间组学图谱
items.summary_zh: 摘要 单细胞空间组学（SCSO）通过在单细胞分辨率下同时实现分子表征和空间定位，重塑了空间分析，为在原生生物背景下理解细胞身份和组织结构提供了洞见。通过整合空间坐标与分子谱和细胞身份，SCSO数据集已被广泛用于构建空间分辨的细胞图谱、表征疾病相关组织重塑以及绘制疾病相关细胞群体。然而，这些SCSO数据集仍分散于各独立出版物中，全面的SCSO资源仍然缺乏。因此，我们开发了scSpatial，一个具有专家策展细胞注释和高分辨率空间映射的SCSO图谱。当前版本的scSpatial策展了大规模SCSO数据集合，包含来自630个项目的1800多个组织切片，使用16种空间技术生成；提供超过2000万个空间分辨细胞，注释为173个标准化Cell Ontology类型；并提供SCSO定制分析和交互式可视化，包括空间基因表达图谱、细胞类型分布图、空间可变基因、基因表达相关性和通路级空间活性谱。scSpati

extra.description: Abstract Single-cell spatial omics (SCSO) has reshaped spatial profiling by enabling simultaneous molecular characterization and spatial mapping at single-cell resolution, providing insights into cellular identities and tissue architecture within native biological contexts. By integrating spatial coordinates with molecular profiles and cell identities, SCSO datasets have been widely used to construct spatially resolved cell atlases, characterize disease-associated tissue remodeling, and map disease-relevant cell populations. However, these SCSO datasets remain fragmented across individual publications, and comprehensive SCSO resources are still lacking. Here, scSpatial was therefore developed as an atlas for SCSO with expert-curated cell annotations and high-resolution spatial mappings. The current release of scSpatial curates a large-scale collection of SCSO data, comprising over 1800 tissue sections from 630 projects generated using 16 spatial technologies; provides >20 million spatially resolved cells annotated into 173 standardized Cell Ontology types; and offers SCSO-tailored analyses and interactive visualizations, including spatial gene expression atlases, cell type distribution maps, spatially variable genes, gene expression correlations, and pathway-level spatial activity profiles. scSpatial is freely accessible to all users without requiring login at https://idrblab.org/scspatial/.

items.title: Stage-resolved multi-omics reveals broad developmental preservation and localized molecular remodeling in cold-shock-induced triploid fish embryos
items.title_zh: 阶段分辨的多组学揭示冷休克诱导三倍体鱼胚胎中广泛的发育保守性和局部分子重塑
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 基因组剂量增加可改变细胞和调控状态，但脊椎动物胚胎在全基因组剂量增加后如何维持协调的发育进程仍不清楚。结果 在此，我们研究了大黄鱼（Larimichthys crocea）冷休克诱导三倍体胚胎发生过程中的发育、转录组和DNA甲基化模式。三倍体胚胎的DNA含量约高1.51倍，并在与二倍体对照相当的时间达到主要发育阶段。在八个阶段中，发育阶段而非倍性主导了全局RNA-seq变异，表明相对转录组组成广泛保守。逐阶段比较识别出局部转录差异主要集中于囊胚期和心跳期。阶段×倍性交互分析揭示了涉及RNA加工、胚胎模式形成、细胞外基质组织和收缩发育的独特发育表达轨迹。三个阶段的全基因组亚硫酸氢盐测序揭示了广泛且双向的区域甲基化差异。相对于可分析的基因组窗口，差异甲基化区域在基因组背景中显示非随机富集，尤其在CpG岛和启动子中富集强烈。然而，启动子、基因体、外显子和内含子背景中的甲基化-表达相关

extra.description: Abstract Background Increased genome dosage can alter cellular and regulatory states, yet how vertebrate embryos maintain coordinated developmental progression following a whole-genome dosage increase remains unclear. Results Here, we examined developmental, transcriptomic, and DNA methylation patterns during cold-shock-induced triploid embryogenesis in large yellow croaker ( Larimichthys crocea ). Triploid embryos exhibited approximately 1.51-fold higher DNA content and reached major developmental stages at times comparable with diploid controls. Across eight stages, developmental stage rather than ploidy dominated global RNA-seq variation, indicating broad preservation of relative transcriptome composition. Stage-wise comparisons identified localized transcriptional differences concentrated primarily at the blastula and heartbeat stages. Stage-by-ploidy interaction analysis revealed distinct developmental expression trajectories involving RNA processing, embryonic patterning, extracellular matrix organization, and contractile development. Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing at three stages revealed extensive and bidirectional regional methylation differences. Relative to analyzable genomic windows, differentially methylated regions showed non-random enrichment across genomic contexts, including particularly strong enrichment in CpG islands and promoters. However, methylation–expression correlations across promoter, gene-body, exonic, and intronic contexts were uniformly weak. Among RNA-testable differentially methylated genes, only seven genes at the blastula stage and two at the heartbeat stage were also differentially expressed, and these overlaps were not greater than expected under independence. Conclusions Cold-shock-induced triploid embryos therefore retain broadly preserved developmental progression and relative transcriptome organization while exhibiting localized transcriptional differences and extensive, genomically structured methylation remodeling. The limited same-stage correspondence between methylation and expression indicates that regional methylation differences are not broadly associated with concurrent transcriptional divergence in bulk embryos.

items.title: scTraitReg: a single-cell multi-omic database of trait-relevant transcription factor eRegulons
items.title_zh: scTraitReg：性状相关转录因子eRegulon的单细胞多组学数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）识别与人类疾病和疾病相关性状相关的位点，但与这些信号相关的调控因子和细胞背景仍难以解析。我们提出scTraitReg，一个单细胞分辨率的性状相关转录因子（TF）eRegulon数据库——包含TF及其靶基因和连锁顺式调控区域。scTraitReg整合了655套 curated GWAS汇总统计，覆盖122个医学主题词（MeSH）疾病术语，以及111个人类单细胞多组学数据集，这些数据集在同一细胞中分析RNA和染色质可及性。该资源涵盖34种组织、252种细胞类型、2 081 538个细胞和2208对 curated GWAS—单细胞分析配对。在这些分析中，它包含886个调控因子的2 840 939条TF–细胞类型记录；67 666条记录满足全部三项标准——细胞类型特异性、遗传相关性和性状相关调控子评分——并被纳入候选性状相关eRegulon记录。每条记录链接到T

extra.description: Abstract Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) identify loci associated with human diseases and disease-related traits, but the regulators and cellular contexts linked to these signals remain difficult to resolve. We present scTraitReg, a database of trait-relevant transcription factor (TF) eRegulons—TFs with their target genes and linked cis-regulatory regions—at single-cell resolution. scTraitReg integrates 655 sets of curated GWAS summary statistics covering 122 Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) disease terms with 111 human single-cell multi-omic datasets profiling RNA and chromatin accessibility in the same cells. The resource spans 34 tissues, 252 cell types, 2 081 538 cells, and 2208 curated GWAS—single-cell analysis pairs. Across these analyses, it contains 2 840 939 TF–cell-type records for 886 regulators; 67 666 records met all three criteria—cell-type specificity, genetic relevance, and the trait-associated regulon score—and were included as candidate trait-relevant eRegulon records. Each record links to the TF—target regulatory network with its cis-regulatory regions, cell-type-resolved evidence, per-cell regulon module scores, and target-gene enrichment, all available as downloadable tables. Users can search by disease, tissue, cell type, or regulator and examine these associations through interactive visualizations. scTraitReg thus provides a searchable and reusable resource linking genetic associations to cell-type-specific regulatory programs, and is freely available at https://www.sctraitreg.bio/.

items.title: SADRP: A structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction
items.title_zh: SADRP：一个用于药物反应预测的结构感知多模态框架
items.summary_zh: 动机：预测不同癌症样本的药物敏感性是个性化治疗和药物发现中的基本挑战。该任务需要对药物和癌细胞系特征进行全面表征。当前方法往往无法充分捕捉药物化合物的复杂结构特征和相互作用，也难以整合来自同一样本的多组学特征，限制了其特征表示能力。因此，需要能够以统一方式联合建模分子结构特征和多模态细胞背景的建模框架。结果：我们提出SADRP，一个用于药物反应预测的结构感知多模态框架，旨在建模复杂分子结构和多组学数据。对于药物表示，SADRP结合了最短距离路径（SDP）编码和边编码，以捕捉拓扑关系和键类型化学语义。对于细胞系分析，多视图交互编码器整合基因表达和DNA甲基化，捕捉跨组学协同互补性。SADRP始终优于最先进的方法，同时还识别出潜在的治疗候选物和生物标志物，提供机制洞察并支持药物发现和个性化医疗中的应用。

extra.description: Motivation Predicting drug sensitivity across diverse cancer samples is a fundamental challenge in personalized therapy and drug discovery. This task requires comprehensive characterization of both drug and cancer cell line features. Current approaches often fail to fully capture the complex structural characteristics and interactions of drug compounds and struggle to integrate multi-omics features derived from the same sample, limiting their feature representation capacity. Consequently, there is a need for modeling frameworks that can jointly model molecular structural features and multi-modal cellular contexts in a unified manner. Results We present SADRP, a structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction, designed to model complex molecular structures and multi-omics data. For drug representation, SADRP incorporates Shortest Distance Path (SDP) encoding and edge encoding to capture both topological relationships and bond-type chemical semantics. For cell line profiling, a multi-view interactive encoder integrates gene expression and DNA methylation, capturing cross-omics synergistic complementarity. SADRP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, while also identifying potential therapeutic candidates and biomarkers, providing mechanistic insights and supporting applications in drug discovery and personalized medicine.

items.title: ImmunEscpMap: a gene-centered knowledgebase for immune escape in cancer and viral infection
items.title_zh: ImmunEscpMap：一个以基因为中心的癌症和病毒感染免疫逃逸知识库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 肿瘤利用免疫逃逸来逃避消除，而病毒重塑宿主免疫以复制或持续存在。然而，解释这些过程的证据分散在数据库、文献和组学分析中，阻碍了基因优先排序。为解决此问题，我们开发了ImmunEscpMap，一个以基因为中心的知识库，在统一的免疫逃逸框架内连接癌症和病毒感染证据。当前版本包含55,711条基因-证据记录（来自37,193个唯一PMID的53,911条PubMed记录和来自709个登录号的1,800条基因表达综合数据库记录），代表667个不同来源基因（癌症中657个，病毒感染中571个，561个共享）。证据组织为八种免疫逃逸机制和14种病毒背景，癌症分支整合多组学和临床结果，病毒分支将机制锚点与感染相关证据分开。网络界面支持标识符搜索、背景浏览、文献视图、交互式基因页面和批量下载。ImmunEscpMap可在https://iescpemap.cqmu.edu.cn/免费获取，提供可追溯

extra.description: Abstract Tumors exploit immune escape to evade elimination, whereas viruses remodel host immunity to replicate or persist. However, evidence to interpret these processes is fragmented across databases, literature, and omics analyses, hindering gene prioritization. To address this, we developed ImmunEscpMap, a gene-centered knowledgebase connecting cancer and viral-infection evidence within a unified immune-escape framework. The current release contains 55 711 gene-evidence records (53 911 PubMed records from 37 193 unique PMIDs and 1800 Gene Expression Omnibus records across 709 accessions) representing 667 distinct source genes (657 in cancer, 571 in viral infection, and 561 shared). Evidence is organized into eight immune-escape mechanisms and 14 viral contexts, with the cancer branch integrating multi-omics and clinical outcomes, and the viral branch separating mechanistic anchors from infection-associated evidence. The web interface supports identifier search, context browsing, literature views, interactive gene pages, and bulk downloads. ImmunEscpMap is freely available at https://iescpemap.cqmu.edu.cn/, providing a traceable cross-domain map to prioritize candidates and guide follow-up experiments.

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.title_zh: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.title_zh: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。
