items.title: Pneuma: A Large-Scale Real-World Time Series Benchmark for Commercial Aircraft Predictive Maintenance
items.title_zh: Pneuma：一个用于商用飞机预测性维护的大规模真实世界时间序列基准
items.summary_zh: 预测性维护对商业航空至关重要，然而进展仍因缺乏公开、大规模真实世界数据集而受阻。因此，大多数方法在专有数据上开发和评估，限制了可重复性。我们推出Pneuma，这是第一个公开可用的大规模基准，使用在役商用飞机的机载时间序列进行预测性维护。Pneuma围绕引气系统构建，包含跨四种飞机类型和9个已验证故障场景的超过9.2亿个多变量时间步，直接与实际维护日志对齐。该数据集展现了关键现实世界挑战，包括显著的类别不平衡、微妙的故障演化模式以及飞机配置间的显著差异。我们围绕三个任务构建基准：多变量预测、监督故障分类和无监督异常检测，标签来自实际维护记录。在统一设置下，我们在9个精心策划的子集上评估了来自四个方法家族的25个以上模型。结果表明，即使强大的当代模型也难以应对微妙的故障特征。进一步分析显示，额外的上下文示例和多变量推理带来一致增益，而预测质量与异常检测性能强烈相关。总之，这些发现为有效建模复杂

extra.description: Predictive maintenance is vital for commercial aviation, yet progress remains hindered by the lack of public, large-scale real-world datasets. As a result, most methods are developed and evaluated on proprietary data, limiting reproducibility. We introduce Pneuma, the first publicly available large-scale benchmark for predictive maintenance using onboard time series from in-service commercial aircraft. Built around bleed air systems, Pneuma contains over 920 million multivariate time steps across four aircraft types and 9 verified fault scenarios, directly aligned with real maintenance logs. The dataset exhibits key real-world challenges, including substantial class imbalance, subtle fault evolution patterns, and significant variance across aircraft configurations. We structure the benchmark around three tasks: multivariate forecasting, supervised fault classification, and unsupervised anomaly detection, with labels derived from actual maintenance records. Under unified settings, we evaluate over 25 models from four methodological families on 9 carefully curated subsets. The results reveal that even strong contemporary models struggle with subtle fault signatures. Further analyses show consistent gains from additional in-context examples and multivariate inference, while forecasting quality is strongly associated with anomaly detection performance. Together, these findings provide practical insights into effectively modeling complex real-world aviation time series. We hope Pneuma will serve as a rigorous and reproducible foundation for advancing data-driven predictive maintenance toward real-world deployment in commercial aviation.

items.title: When uncertainty quantification fails: structural vulnerabilities and corrections for selective prediction under clinical class imbalance
items.title_zh: 当不确定性量化失败时：临床类别不平衡下选择性预测的结构脆弱性和修正
items.summary_zh: 背景。选择性预测系统通过将模糊病例推迟给人类专家，同时自动化高置信度决策，提高临床人工智能的安全性。然而，这种安全机制完全依赖于不确定性分数准确反映临床模糊性的前提。在以严重类别不平衡为特征的预后任务中，感兴趣的临床结果是少数，这一假设失效。标准不确定性度量不再捕捉临床对齐的模糊性；相反，它们成为类别归属的代理，系统性地惩罚少数患者，无论其个体预测清晰度如何。结果。在56个合成条件和三个神经退行性队列（多发性硬化、帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病）中，跨越严重类别不平衡到接近平衡的条件，我们的框架在轨迹上一致保持有界、平衡的风险。相比之下，全局指标要么使少数类敏感性崩溃，要么以牺牲多数患者为代价保护少数类。将CCR与标准熵结合未能保护少数类，因为当tau=0.5时它破坏了类内单调性。将CCR与阈值感知指标结合恢复了严格单调性，正确识别模糊患者，并安全减轻少数类排除。结论。在临床类别不平衡下，标准不确

extra.description: Background. Selective prediction systems improve the safety of clinical artificial intelligence by deferring ambiguous cases to human experts while automating high-confidence decisions. However, this safety mechanism relies entirely on the premise that uncertainty scores accurately reflect clinical ambiguity. In prognostic tasks characterized by severe class imbalance, where the clinical outcome of interest is a minority, this assumption breaks down. Standard uncertainty measures cease to capture clinically aligned ambiguity; instead, they become a proxy for class membership, systematically penalizing minority patients regardless of their individual predictive clarity. Results. Across 56 synthetic conditions and three neurodegenerative cohorts spanning severe class imbalance to near-balanced conditions (multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Alzheimer's Disease), our framework consistently maintained bounded, balanced risk across trajectories. In contrast, global metrics either collapsed minority Sensitivity or protected the minority at the expense of majority patients. Applying CCR with standard entropy fails to protect the minority because it breaks within-class monotonicity when tau=0.5. Combining CCR with threshold-aware metrics restores strict monotonicity, correctly identifies ambiguous patients, and safely mitigates minority exclusion. Conclusions. Under clinical class imbalance, standard uncertainty quantification measures dataset sparsity rather than clinical ambiguity, creating a systemic illusion of safety. This bias is a correctable structural flaw. Clinical pipelines deploying selective prediction under imbalance should adopt threshold-aligned uncertainty measures and class-stratified evaluation. This reduces class-specific risk imbalance, supporting safer selective prediction under the evaluated conditions without silently excluding the most vulnerable patients.

items.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
items.title_zh: 安全头部：学习到的注意力门控提升提示注入鲁棒性
items.summary_zh: 我们提出安全头部（HoS），一种提示注入防御方法，通过一小组学习到的逐头注意力门控来强制指令-数据分离。HoS学习每个头应如何在可信与不可信token之间重新分配注意力，使模型能够对不可信内容进行推理而不遵循注入的指令。我们在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和GPT-OSS-20B上评估HoS。我们将其与SecAlign++（一种最先进的基于微调的防御）和ASIDE（一种与我们的方法类似、将指令-数据分离构建到模型架构中的防御）进行比较。我们表明，HoS对自适应攻击具有更强的鲁棒性，在标准效用基准上表现更好，并在标准智能体提示注入基准上达到顶级性能。更具体地说，黑盒RL-Hammer攻击对GPT-OSS-20B达到97%的攻击成功率，对SecAlign达到85%，但对HoS仅达到10%。Claudini是一种最先进的白盒攻击，通过自动研究针对HoS进行了增强，其在HoS上达到相

extra.description: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.

items.title: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
items.title_zh: 注意力作为格点规范理论：关系仅通过Wilson环相互作用
items.summary_zh: 关系通过它们共享的实体进行组合——Alice是Bob的母亲，Bob是Carol的父亲，所以Alice是Carol的祖母——而且顺序很重要，因为父亲的母亲不是母亲的父亲；验证组合关系意味着闭合环路。我们表明，如果每个实体的坐标框架可以独立旋转（逐实体框架自由度），则有三件事随之而来。在纯规范扇区中，不共享任何循环的关系完全不能相互作用。三角形的唯一规范不变评分是其完整群$H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki}$的类函数——一个Wilson环。而边的唯一等变更新是$U = Ψ(H)\, T_{ij}$，其中$Ψ$是共轭等变的。因此，通过Wilson环进行的边注意力不是众多设计之一，而是对称性所允许的唯一形式。三个社区持有这种形式的部分内容：知识图谱的交换算子嵌入是其阿贝尔（交换）扇区；AlphaFold的三角形更新和Edge Transformer具有其形状——通过第三个顶点更新边—

extra.description: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's father; verifying a composed relation means closing the loop. We show that if each entity's coordinate frame may be rotated independently (per-entity frame freedom), three things follow. In the pure-gauge sector, relations that share no cycle cannot interact at all. The only gauge-invariant score of a triangle is a class function of its holonomy $H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki}$ - a Wilson loop. And the only equivariant update of an edge is $U = Ψ(H)\, T_{ij}$ with $Ψ$ conjugation-equivariant. Edge attention by Wilson loops is therefore not one design among many but the unique form the symmetry permits. Three communities hold pieces of this form: the commuting-operator embeddings of knowledge graphs are its abelian (commuting) sector; AlphaFold's triangle update and the Edge Transformer have its shape - an edge updated through the third vertex - without its constraints; and lattice QCD builds it equivariantly on lattices. We instantiate the equivariant sub-family on general relational graphs as holonomy attention. With no training and composition alone, it infers unobserved $S_4$ relations on sparse graphs at 0.88 with a fifth of the edges corrupted, at or slightly below specialist synchronization algorithms, where every commutative architecture is capped at 0.083; its holonomy score flags corrupted triangles at AUC 0.99 where commuting scores are capped at 0.76 by a second selection rule, and it separates clusters without labels.

items.title: KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
items.title_zh: KPPax：为大气化学中的机器学习预处理可微动力学ODE
items.summary_zh: 大气化学机理通常以动力学预处理器（KPP）语言分发，该语言生成高效的Fortran或C代码，但不适合开发机器学习模型所用的可微编程框架。我们提出KPPax，一种动力学预处理器，可从KPP语言编写的机理生成JAX中可微、即时编译且可向量化的化学代码。KPPax在对数空间中使用稀疏操作评估速率定律，保持其可微性，并使用\texttt{diffrax}库的隐式求解器和前向及反向模式伴随来积分刚性系统，从而无需手工推导伴随代码即可获得精确灵敏度。我们使用POLLU基准机理演示了两个应用。在第一个中，从自动微分雅可比矩阵计算的Fisher信息矩阵在任何拟合之前预测流动管式设计可以识别25个速率系数中的哪些，噪声合成估计确认了九个可识别速率系数的预测不确定性在约30%以内，同时揭示了仅受比率约束的快速反应簇。在第二个中，排放清单的神经网络校正首先在逐场景4D-Var反演上离线训练，然后通过化学模型在线

extra.description: Atmospheric chemical mechanisms are commonly distributed in the language of the Kinetic PreProcessor (KPP), which generates efficient Fortran or C code but does not fit into the differentiable programming frameworks in which machine-learning models are developed. We present KPPax, a kinetic preprocessor that generates differentiable, just-in-time compiled, and vectorisable chemistry code in JAX from mechanisms written in the KPP language. KPPax evaluates the rate law with sparse operations in log space, which keeps it differentiable, and integrates the stiff system with the implicit solvers and the forward- and reverse-mode adjoints of the \texttt{diffrax} library, so that exact sensitivities are obtained without hand-derived adjoint code. We demonstrate two applications with the POLLU benchmark mechanism. In the first, the Fisher information matrix computed from an automatically differentiated Jacobian predicts, before any fit, which of the 25 rate coefficients a flow-tube-like design can identify, and noisy synthetic estimation confirms the predicted uncertainties of the nine identifiable rate coefficients to within about 30\% while revealing clusters of fast reactions of which only ratios are constrained. In the second, a neural-network correction of an emission inventory is trained offline on per-scenario 4D-Var retrievals and then fine-tuned online through the chemical model, which reduces the error of the biogenic correction by a factor of 2.4--5 and recovers information on low-temperature emissions that the individual retrievals lose. KPPax makes KPP mechanisms directly usable for parameter estimation and hybrid physics--machine-learning modelling.

items.title: Scaling Laws for Tool-Use Agents via Controllable Environment Synthesis
items.title_zh: 工具使用智能体的缩放定律：通过可控环境合成
items.summary_zh: 我们探索如何构建能够完成复杂多步任务的高性能大语言模型（LLM）工具使用智能体。具体而言，我们研究合成生成的工具使用环境中的数据组成如何影响此类智能体的训练。为此，我们提出SynthAPI流水线，它沿工具、任务以及工具所操作的数据库等维度显式控制生成环境的多样性。通过在458,752个任务中系统地变化SynthAPI的生成控制，并训练四种不同规模的849个模型，我们推导出一个缩放定律，根据合成环境的规模和组成预测下游工具使用智能体的泛化能力。这些可预测的关系揭示了扩展工具使用智能体数据的若干经验。随着数据预算增长，扩展工具和数据库多样性比增加任务数量更有效，而增加数据复杂性会产生更大收益。根据这些发现进行扩展，所得到的智能体在四个评估基准上优于使用先前工作数据训练的大规模工具使用智能体和合成环境生成模型。

extra.description: We explore how to build performant large language model (LLM) tool-use agents that complete complex, multi-step tasks. Specifically, we study how data composition in synthetically generated tool-use environments affects the training of such agents. To do so, we propose the SynthAPI pipeline, which explicitly controls the diversity of generated environments along the axes of tools, tasks, and the databases on which the tools operate. By systematically varying SynthAPI's generation controls in 458,752 tasks across 849 trained models of four different sizes, we derive a scaling law that predicts downstream tool-use agent generalization based on the scale and composition of the synthesized environments. These predictable relationships reveal several lessons for scaling tool-use agent data. As data budgets grow, scaling tool and database diversity becomes more effective than increasing the number of tasks, and increasing data complexity yields larger gains. Scaling according to these findings yields agents that outperform models trained on data from prior work in large-scale tool-use agent and synthetic environment generation across four evaluation benchmarks.

items.title: What Improves During Pretraining? Tracking Knowledge Acquisition with Point-in-Time Models
items.title_zh: 预训练期间什么在提升？用时间点模型追踪知识获取
items.summary_zh: 在多年收集的网络语料上预训练的语言模型学习通用和领域特定知识。这些不同类型的知识在预训练过程中如何被学习仍不清楚。最近在不同年份的网络快照上训练的时间点模型提供了一种探测知识流行度随时间变化的方法。使用这些模型，我们提出时间变异性评分（TVS），定义为项目负对数似然在模型间的变异系数。较高的评分表明该知识在多年网络文本中可能表示得不太一致。我们使用来自多个开源模型家族的六个模型评估涵盖不同主题的六个基准。我们发现低和高TVS项目在训练早期学习情况相似，但高TVS项目在后期提升更快。在预训练运行结束时，高TVS项目在36个模型-基准设置中的34个中优于低TVS项目，平均优势为7.3个百分点的机会归一化准确率。这种模式在知识密集型任务上最为稳健，即使在比较难度相似的项目时也是如此。我们的发现揭示了预训练过程中知识学习方式的差异，时间变异性提供了超越聚合基准评分的这些学习动态的诊断。

extra.description: Language models pretrained on web corpora collected over multiple years learn both general and domain-specific knowledge. How these different kinds of knowledge are learned as pretraining progresses remains unclear. Recent point-in-time models trained on web snapshots from different years provide a way to probe how knowledge prevalence varies over time. Using these models, we propose a temporal variability score (TVS), defined as the coefficient of variation of an item's negative log-likelihood across models. A higher score suggests that the knowledge may be less consistently represented across years of web text. We evaluate six benchmarks covering diverse topics using six models from multiple open-source model families. We find that low- and high-TVS items are learned similarly early in training, but high-TVS items improve faster later on. At the end of the pretraining run, high-TVS items outperform low-TVS items in 34 of 36 model-benchmark settings, with an average advantage of 7.3 points of chance-normalized accuracy. This pattern is most robust on knowledge-intensive tasks, even when comparing items of similar difficulty. Our findings reveal differences in how knowledge is learned over the course of pretraining, with temporal variability providing a diagnostic of these learning dynamics beyond aggregate benchmark scores.

items.title: Rare, Relevant, and Still Wrong: How Memory Fails LLM Group Decisions
items.title_zh: 稀有、相关但仍然错误：记忆如何使LLM群体决策失败
items.summary_zh: 当一个LLM群体的讨论被压缩为最终决策者的简短记忆时，记忆应该保留什么？两种自然的启发式方法保留最稀有的主张或与决策标准相关的主张。在隐藏剖面任务中，两者看起来都有吸引力，因为一个事实被持有的广泛程度与它是否有帮助相混淆。我们引入CrossProfile，一个包含60个模板的诊断基准，其答案键经过自动验证，其中支持性、诱饵和无关事实的归属被交叉而文本保持不变（480个任务）。在Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B和两个DeepSeek模型中，两种启发式方法在可预测的地方都失败了。按相关性选择会重新引入诱饵，因为诱饵是切题的：即使完美的相关性过滤器在经典隐藏剖面配置中也比最稀有优先选择低23到31分。最稀有优先选择平均而言并不比随机选择好，仅在稀有事实恰好是有用事实时才获胜。在两种情况下，准确率都跟随记忆保留的证据平衡，而不是保留它的策略。决策模型增加了第三种失败，一种社会证明形式

extra.description: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.

items.title: VideoLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning over Grounded Video Evidence
items.title_zh: VideoLVR：基于接地视频证据的潜在视觉推理
items.summary_zh: 思维链推理大幅推进了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中的视频理解。然而，基于语言的推理轨迹不为模型提供重新访问相关视觉证据的可靠机制，导致视觉遗忘并损害其推理视频内容的能力。现有方法以两种主要方式在推理过程中保持视觉接地：它们要么使用文本坐标引用证据，这指定了符号位置而非视觉内容本身，要么将裁剪区域或帧重新插入多模态上下文，以大量上下文扩展为代价保留视觉细节。为解决这些限制，我们引入VideoLVR，它从相关视频时刻的局部区域构建潜在视觉证据，从而为中间推理步骤提供视觉支持。为监督潜在视觉证据生成，我们引入视觉token预测目标，将视觉token重建表述为对从输入视频派生的词汇表的预测，从而在同一token预测框架内统一视觉证据重建和文本生成。这种共享预测框架使MLLM能够对交错的文本token和潜在视觉状态进行推理，同时整合来自不同时刻的证据。我们进一步将VideoLVR扩展到强化学习，将采

extra.description: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, language-based reasoning traces do not provide a reliable mechanism for models to revisit relevant visual evidence, leading to visual forgetting and impairing their ability to reason over video content. Existing approaches maintain visual grounding during reasoning in two main ways: they either refer to evidence using textual coordinates, which specify symbolic locations rather than the visual content itself, or reinsert cropped regions or frames into the multimodal context, preserving visual details at the cost of substantial context expansion. To address these limitations, we introduce VideoLVR, which constructs latent visual evidence from local regions at relevant video moments, thereby providing visual support for intermediate reasoning steps. To supervise latent visual evidence generation, we introduce a visual token prediction objective that formulates visual token reconstruction as prediction over a vocabulary derived from the input video, thereby unifying visual evidence reconstruction and text generation within the same token prediction framework. This shared prediction framework enables MLLMs to reason over interleaved text tokens and latent visual states while integrating evidence from different moments. We further extend VideoLVR to reinforcement learning by treating sampled visual tokens as actions alongside text tokens and jointly optimizing the policy using final-answer rewards. By efficiently revisiting task-relevant visual information during reasoning, VideoLVR improves video understanding without substantially expanding the multimodal context. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, especially on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.

items.title: MoI-Bench: A Benchmark for Image Generation and Editing on Mobile Devices
items.title_zh: MoI-Bench：移动设备上图像生成与编辑的基准
items.summary_zh: 开发端侧图像模型需要考虑实际用户需求、任务类型和设备资源约束。然而，现有基准在识别端侧模型与服务器端模型之间的能力差距方面提供的指导有限。我们引入MoI-Bench，一个基于移动用户需求的基准，包含64个子任务和1150个样本。它定义了16种操作，如移除和替换，以及八个视觉目标类别，涵盖肖像和文本等内容。这些形成两个正交轴，其适用组合定义了特定任务，如移除面部妆容。为更好地指导模型改进，我们进一步提出MoI-Eval，引入涵盖指令遵循、视觉质量和细节保留的任务特定标准。我们进一步构建样本级评估问题，并将其评分聚合为沿操作、目标和标准轴的总体质量和能力概况。我们评估代表性的端侧和服务器端模型并测量移动部署成本。结果表明，这种解耦的操作×目标设计为改进紧凑模型提供了更细粒度的指导。例如，它强调需要优先考虑特定能力差距（如文本替换）而非广泛的应用级目标（如改进文本编辑）。与传统使用单一评分对模型

extra.description: Developing on-device image models requires considering practical user needs, task types and device resource constraints. However, existing benchmarks provide limited guidance on identifying capability gaps between on-device models and server-side models. We introduce MoI-Bench, a benchmark grounded in mobile user needs, comprising 64 subtasks and 1150 samples. It defines 16 operations, such as removal and replacement, and eight visual target categories covering content such as portraits and text. These form two orthogonal axes whose applicable combinations define specific tasks, such as removing facial makeup. To better guide model improvement, we further propose MoI-Eval, which introduces task-specific criteria covering instruction following, visual quality and detail preservation. We further construct sample-level evaluation questions and aggregate their scores into overall quality and capability profiles along the operation, target and criteria axes. We evaluate representative on-device and server-side models and measure mobile deployment costs. Results show that this decoupled Operation x Target design provides finer-grained guidance for improving compact models. For example, it highlights the need to prioritize specific capability gaps (e.g., text-replacement) over broad application-level goals (e.g., improving text editing). Unlike conventional benchmarks that rank models using a single score, we introduce a two-dimensional Quality-Deployability capability map to assess models for practical mobile use. The map shows that current on-device models can achieve efficient generation or editing but expanding their task coverage deserves greater attention than further improving deployment efficiency. Further progress requires improving editing quality, particularly identity preservation and text rendering, while broadening task coverage.

items.title: GAS-PFN: Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Zero-Shot Traffic Forecasting
items.title_zh: GAS-PFN：用于零样本交通预测的图感知时空先验数据拟合网络
items.summary_zh: 交通预测需要建模复杂的时间动态和道路拓扑施加的空间依赖。监督图基模型实现了强大性能，但通常针对特定数据集和传感器图训练，使得部署到新的或演进的网络成本高昂。先验数据拟合网络（PFN）通过从合成任务先验中学习上下文推理提供零样本替代方案，这提供了编码领域特定假设的显式机制。然而，现有预测PFN没有显式表示支配交通动态的图结构依赖。为将图感知交通建模与零样本适应相结合，我们引入图感知时空先验数据拟合网络（GAS-PFN）。GAS-PFN通过随机游走扩散将采样的道路拓扑纳入其合成任务先验，在预训练期间教模型学习图耦合动态。其协同设计的推理架构使用两次掩码条件化通过共享Transformer骨干，分别建模传感器特定的时间动态和相邻传感器之间的时空交互，然后整合它们的表示进行预测。这种设计使GAS-PFN能够使用目标网络结构和上下文而无需参数更新。在90分钟预测范围的六个基准上，GAS-PFN相对于

extra.description: Traffic forecasting requires modeling complex temporal dynamics and the spatial dependencies imposed by road topology. Supervised graph-based models achieve strong performance, but are often trained for a particular dataset and sensor graph, making deployment to new or evolving networks costly. Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) offer a zero-shot alternative by learning in-context inference from synthetic task priors, which provide an explicit mechanism for encoding domain-specific assumptions. Existing forecasting PFNs, however, do not explicitly represent the graph-structured dependencies governing traffic dynamics. To combine graph-aware traffic modeling with zero-shot adaptation, we introduce the Graph-Aware Spatiotemporal Prior-Data Fitted Network (GAS-PFN). GAS-PFN incorporates sampled road topology into its synthetic task prior through random-walk diffusion, teaching the model to learn graph-coupled dynamics during pretraining. Its co-designed inference architecture uses two mask-conditioned passes through a shared Transformer backbone to separately model sensor-specific temporal dynamics and spatiotemporal interactions among neighboring sensors before integrating their representations for prediction. This design enables GAS-PFN to use target-network structure and context without parameter updates. Across six benchmarks at the 90-minute horizon, GAS-PFN reduces MSE by 34.0% on average relative to TimePFN, its closest PFN-based predecessor. It also reduces MSE by 27.7% on average relative to four recent industry-developed general-purpose zero-shot forecasters. In this comparison, all models receive 90 minutes of contiguous recent history, and any additional context is drawn from each dataset's chronological training split. These results indicate that aligning PFN priors and inference architectures with graph structure improves in-context learning for zero-shot traffic forecasting.

items.title: Timestral
items.title_zh: Timestral
items.summary_zh: 我们引入Timestral，一个包含四个概率预测时间序列基础模型的家族，参数量分别为5M、28M、123M和209M。Timestral在GIFT-Eval、TIME和fev-bench上创造了新的最先进水平，其中Timestral-209M和Timestral-123M在每个指标上占据前两名。我们通过三个要素实现这一点：解耦预测范围（DHF），将预测token与因果编码的上下文分离，使得训练更长范围时无需掩码上下文，且每个观测值既是预测目标又是后续预测的上下文；一个协变量框架，在因果架构中原生支持已知未来协变量；以及一个两阶段流水线，首先仅在多样的大规模合成语料上预训练，然后在混合真实和合成数据上使用扩展上下文进行后训练。本报告描述了模型设计及其基准结果。所有四个模型的权重可在Hugging Face上获取，推理代码在GitHub上。

extra.description: We introduce Timestral, a family of four time series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, with 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameters. Timestral sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, where Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two places on every metric. We achieve this with three ingredients: Decoupled Horizon Forecasting (DHF), which separates prediction tokens from the causally encoded context, so that longer horizons are trained without masking context and each observed value is both a forecast target and context for later forecasts; a covariate framework that natively supports known-future covariates within a causal architecture; and a two-stage pipeline that pretrains exclusively on a diverse, large-scale synthetic corpus before post-training on a mix of real and synthetic data with extended context. This report describes the model design and its benchmark results. Weights for all four models are available on Hugging Face and inference code on GitHub.

items.title: REGER: Modeling inter-item Relations with Semantic IDs for Generative Recommendation
items.title_zh: REGER：用语义ID建模项目间关系用于生成式推荐
items.summary_zh: 个性化推荐依赖于从在线内容和用户交互中学习项目间的语义和协同关系。生成式推荐（GR）通过自回归生成项目的离散语义ID（SID）提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，随机初始化的SID token嵌入和从头训练的GR模型不直接继承项目中固有的语义关系，而项目间协同关系主要通过token级注意力和下一token监督隐式学习。为解决这一限制，我们提出REGER，一个统一框架，将项目间关系显式纳入语义预训练、历史编码和SID生成。我们通过生成式语义检索预训练GR模型，使其通过学习生成语义邻居的SID来继承项目间语义相似性。我们将全局注意力与对齐SID边界的局部注意力相结合，以捕获历史上下文和相邻项目之间的有向转换。我们进一步开发了一个理论框架，用于SID前缀树上的分层偏好分解，证明了协同偏好分布的精确因子分解以及项目级KL散度到前缀条件KL散度的加权分解。基于此分析，我们在目标SID路径上的真实前缀处蒸馏

extra.description: Personalized recommendation depends on learning semantic and collaborative relations among items from online content and user interactions. Generative recommendation (GR) offers a promising paradigm by autoregressively generating discrete semantic IDs (SIDs) of items. However, randomly initialized SID token embeddings and GR models trained from scratch do not directly inherit the semantic relations inherent in items, while inter-item collaborative relations are learned largely implicitly through token-level attention and next-token supervision. To address this limitation, we propose REGER, a unified framework that explicitly incorporates inter-item relations into semantic pretraining, history encoding, and SID generation. We pretrain the GR model through generative semantic retrieval, enabling it to inherit inter-item semantic similarity by learning to generate semantic neighbors' SIDs. We combine global attention with local attention aligned with SID boundaries to capture historical context and directed transitions between adjacent items. We further develop a theoretical framework for hierarchical preference decomposition over the SID prefix tree, proving an exact factorization of collaborative preference distributions and a weighted decomposition of item-level KL divergence into prefix-conditional KL divergences. Building on this analysis, we distill a discriminative teacher's full conditional distributions over all legal next tokens at ground-truth prefixes along the target SID path, jointly optimizing this objective with cross-entropy. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing GR baselines and support the effectiveness of the proposed preference distillation.

items.title: Spectral Braids: A Topological Descriptor for Dynamic Directed Networks
items.title_zh: 谱辫：动态有向网络的拓扑描述符
items.summary_zh: 特征值是图机器学习的骨干：谱聚类、谱图神经网络和图核都通过矩阵的特征值来总结网络。这些特征值几乎总是被视为静态的数字列表。然而，当图变化时，其特征值会移动，而当矩阵非对称时，它们在复平面中移动，可能相互缠绕。这种缠绕的模式是一个辫，拓扑学中的经典对象。我们提出谱辫，一种用于动态有向网络的方法论：每个快照被聚合为社区级转移矩阵，其复特征值随时间追踪，它们描绘的辫被读取为一个词。然后该词通过Burau表示映射为矩阵，为任何分类器提供固定大小的特征向量。辫具有具体含义：每个特征值描述一组社区的行为方式，每个交叉记录一组超越另一组。我们在动态网络分类上评估该方法，使用在线社区的合成网络，其标签描述网络在相同起始和结束状态之间如何演变。我们的实验结果表明，所提出的特征在四个类别上达到97.1%的准确率，而不追踪特征值的最佳特征集为44.5%，且Burau特征还能分离包含相同事件但顺序不同的网络，这是

extra.description: Eigenvalues are a workhorse of graph machine learning: spectral clustering, spectral graph neural networks, and graph kernels all summarize a network by the eigenvalues of a matrix. These eigenvalues are almost always treated as a static list of numbers. When a graph changes, however, its eigenvalues move, and when the matrix is not symmetric, they move in the complex plane, where they can wind around each other. The pattern of this winding is a braid, a classical object from topology. We propose spectral braids, a methodology for dynamic directed networks: each snapshot is aggregated into a community-level transition matrix, its complex eigenvalues are tracked over time, and the braid they trace is read off as a word. The word is then mapped to a matrix by the Burau representation, which gives a fixed-size feature vector for any classifier. The braid has a concrete meaning: each eigenvalue describes how a group of communities behaves, and each crossing records one group overtaking another. We evaluate the method on dynamic network classification, using synthetic networks of online communities whose labels describe how the network evolved between the same starting and ending states. Our experimental results show that the proposed features reach 97.1% accuracy on four classes, against 44.5% for the best feature set that does not track eigenvalues, and that the Burau features also separate networks containing the same events in a different order, which simple counts of crossings cannot do. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study that defines braids and braid monodromy on graph data and uses them as features for learning on dynamic networks.

items.title: TeamGym: A Gym for Team Decision-Making by AI Agents with Distributed Information
items.title_zh: TeamGym：具有分布式信息的AI智能体团队决策训练场
items.summary_zh: 许多现实世界决策需要团队整合分布在参与者之间的信息。然而，AI智能体仍然主要在孤立环境中训练和基准测试。我们引入TeamGym，一个用于评估和训练基于语言模型的智能体解决团队决策问题的环境，这些问题由真实世界的法律、金融、医疗和软件工程语料构建。TeamGym引入一种方法来识别最小事实集，其中每个元素都是必要的且所有元素 collectively 足以做出正确的最终决策，我们称之为关键信息。这使TeamGym既能控制关键信息的分布，又能追踪智能体在团队决策中识别和整合关键信息的效果。在12个源语料上检查8个语言模型，我们发现当前AI智能体往往无法有效共享信息：将关键信息分布在参与者之间，相对于将相同信息给予单个模型，平均降低成功率22.9个百分点（通信差距）。我们还记录了参与者不能有效自行检索决策相关信息：当参与者必须从源材料中识别和提取关键信息而非直接接收时，团队成功率进一步降低19.9

extra.description: Many real-world decisions require teams to integrate information distributed across participants. Yet AI agents are still primarily trained and benchmarked in isolation. We introduce TeamGym, an environment for evaluating and training language model-based agents on team decision-making problems constructed from real-world legal, finance, medical, and software engineering corpora. TeamGym introduces a method to identify a minimal set of facts, each element of which is necessary and all of which are collectively sufficient for a correct final decision, which we call pivotal information. This enables TeamGym to both control the distribution of pivotal information and track how well agents identify and integrate pivotal information when making team decisions. Examining 8 language models on 12 source corpora, we find that current AI agents often fail to effectively share information: Distributing pivotal information across participants lowers success rate by 22.9 percentage points on average relative to giving the same information to a single model (a communication gap). We also document that participants do not effectively retrieve decision-relevant information on their own: A team's success rate is lowered by a further 19.9 points when participants must identify and extract pivotal information from source material rather than receiving it directly (a retrieval gap). To help remedy these deficits, we use TeamGym to train policies through reinforcement learning on team decision loss. Across two policy-training experiments, we find that training improves final-decision quality and induces emergent coordination in participation, speaker selection, and communication, even though the reward evaluates only the final decision.

items.title: GroundControl: Satellite-Conditioned Multi-View Diffusion for Reconstruction-Free Novel View Synthesis
items.title_zh: GroundControl：卫星条件化的多视图扩散用于免重建新视图合成
items.summary_zh: 多视图或视频扩散模型最近已成为从稀疏图像集合进行新视图合成的最先进方法。虽然它们可以产生高质量图像，但在合成输入视图之外的视图（场景外推）时，它们倾向于幻觉出不现实的空间布局。我们提出通过使用卫星图像作为额外信息源来条件化多视图生成模型，以解决户外场景中的这一挑战。我们引入一种新的卫星条件化多视图扩散模型，在生成新视图时结合来自卫星图像和街景输入图像的条件化。我们基于交叉注意力的条件化允许我们保留预训练的多视图扩散先验，从少量源视图生成无缝、逼真的新视图，同时遵循从卫星图像看到的场景布局。我们的模型不使用3D场景重建，仅依赖有姿态的街景和卫星视图。我们在户外数据集上的实验表明，我们的模型在新视图合成上优于卫星条件化或街景条件化的基线，特别是在目标视图与源视图重叠很少的挑战性情况下。项目页面：https://nianticspatial.github.io/groundcontrol

extra.description: Multi-view or video diffusion models have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for novel-view synthesis from sparse image collections. While they can produce high quality images, they tend to hallucinate unrealistic spatial layouts when synthesizing views outside the input views (scene extrapolation). We propose to address this challenge for outdoor scenes by using satellite images as an additional information source to condition the multi-view generative model. We introduce a new satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model that combines conditioning from a satellite image and street-level input images when generating novel-views. Our cross-attention based conditioning allows us to retain pretrained multi-view diffusion priors to generate seamless, realistic, novel views from a handful of source views, while also adhering to the scene layout as seen from satellite images. Our model does not use 3D scene reconstruction, and only relies on posed street and satellite views. Our experiments on outdoor datasets show that our model is better than both satellite-conditioned or street-view conditioned baselines on novel-view synthesis, especially on challenging cases where target views have very little overlap with source views. Project page: https://nianticspatial.github.io/groundcontrol

items.title: VIOLIN: A modular framework for scalable reconciliation of heterogeneous interaction graphs
items.title_zh: VIOLIN：用于异构交互图可扩展协调的模块化框架
items.summary_zh: 从科学文献中自动提取分子相互作用已超过将这些信息与 curated 模型和知识图谱整合的系统方法的发展。在此我们提出VIOLIN（Versatile Interaction Organizing to Leverage Information in Networks），一个可配置、属性感知的协调框架，正式将新提取的交互列表与结构化基线图进行比较。VIOLIN将每个交互分类为佐证、矛盾、标记案例或扩展，并支持可配置的属性包含策略和不匹配语义以调整协调严格度。我们使用两个传统NLP系统（REACH、INDRA）和两个大语言模型（GPT-4.1、Llama 3）在多个文献语料和结构不同的基线图上生成的交互列表评估VIOLIN。在所有条件下，协调结果稳定且可解释，扩展占主导，佐证-矛盾平衡反映了基线图与提取证据之间的内在结构关系。敏感性分析表明，属性包含和分类方案选择可预测地移动类别边界。基准评估

extra.description: Automated extraction of molecular interactions from scientific literature has outpaced the development of systematic methods for integrating this information with curated models and knowledge graphs. Here we present VIOLIN (Versatile Interaction Organizing to Leverage Information in Networks), a configurable, attribute-aware reconciliation framework that formally compares newly extracted interaction lists against structured baseline graphs. VIOLIN classifies each interaction as a corroboration, contradiction, flagged case, or extension, and supports configurable attribute inclusion strategies and mismatch semantics to adjust reconciliation strictness. We evaluate VIOLIN using interaction lists generated by two traditional NLP systems (REACH, INDRA) and two large language models (GPT-4.1, Llama 3) across multiple literature corpora and structurally distinct baseline graphs. Across all conditions, reconciliation outcomes were stable and interpretable, with extensions dominating and corroboration-contradiction balance reflecting intrinsic structural relationships between baseline graphs and extracted evidence. Sensitivity analyses demonstrate that attribute inclusion and classification scheme selection shift category boundaries predictably. Benchmark evaluations confirm high algorithmic correctness and alignment with expert curation. VIOLIN is publicly available as a Python package and through web-based interface (https://nmzlab.github.io/Tools-UI).

items.title: A Plasmodium falciparum Pangenome Resource to Drive Structural Variant Discovery and to assist Malaria Control
items.title_zh: 恶性疟原虫泛基因组资源以推动结构变异发现并协助疟疾控制
items.summary_zh: 恶性疟原虫是疟疾最致命的病原体，拥有广泛的结构变异，这些变异是耐药性和诊断逃逸等关键生物学过程的基础。在此我们提出PfPan，一个使用Minigraph-Cactus从13个地理多样化的高质量参考基因组构建的恶性疟原虫泛基因组，在3D7线性参考之外增加了4.77 Mb序列。我们在参考基因组中识别了超过5,000个结构变异（SV），并证明使用vg工具包相比基于线性参考的方法改善了基因分型，在小变异发现方面性能相当。与组装衍生的真值集进行基准测试确认了泛基因组在结构变异检测方面的优越性，特别是在复杂和高变位点。将PfPan应用于878个全球采样的恶性疟原虫全基因组序列，我们表征了生物学和临床相关的SV，包括复杂的耐药性相关gch1位点，并探索了诊断靶标HRP2编码序列上游的缺失。PfPan为减轻恶性疟原虫基因组监测中的参考偏差提供了基础资源，并建立了一个框架，用于改进在未经过选择性全基因组扩增

extra.description: Plasmodium falciparum, the deadliest causative agent of malaria, harbours extensive structural variation that underlies key biological processes including drug resistance and diagnostic evasion. Here, we present PfPan, a P. falciparum pangenome constructed from 13 geographically diverse high-quality reference genomes using Minigraph-Cactus, adding 4.77 Mb of sequence beyond the 3D7 linear reference. We identify over 5,000 structural variants (SVs) across the reference genomes and demonstrate improved genotyping using the vg toolkit compared to linear reference-based approaches, with comparable performance for small variant discovery. Benchmarking against assembly-derived truth sets confirms pangenome superiority for structural variant detection, particularly at complex and hypervariable loci. Applying PfPan to 878 globally sampled P. falciparum whole-genome sequences, we characterise biologically and clinically relevant SVs, including the complex drug resistance-linked gch1 locus, and explore deletions upstream of the coding sequence for the diagnostic target HRP2. PfPan provides a foundational resource for mitigating reference bias in P. falciparum genomic surveillance and establishes a framework for improved detection of variants associated with drug resistance and malaria control in monoclonal P. falciparum samples that have not undergone selective whole-genome amplification.

items.title: Efficient permuted intron-exon RNA circularization system based on the LtrB group II Intron from Lactococcus lactis
items.title_zh: 基于乳酸乳球菌LtrB II型内含子的高效置换内含子-外显子RNA环化系统
items.summary_zh: 环状RNA（circRNA）已成为稳定RNA表达和治疗应用的有前景平台，但其生成方法仍然有限。在此，我们将乳酸乳球菌LtrB II型内含子工程化为置换内含子-外显子（PIE）配置，以实现高效的circRNA形成（circLtrB）。在测试的拆分设计中，LtrB结构域IV切割产生最高的环化效率。尽管LtrB编码体内高效剪接所需的LtrA成熟酶，但将LtrA体外应用于PIE构建体导致比自剪接条件更低的环化效率。我们进一步检查了不同盐条件下的环化，表明NH4Cl和KCl基剪接缓冲液独立支持高环化效率（>80%），同时产生不同的剪接中间体，表明离子特异性机制对环化的影响。延长外部同源臂未增强环化效率，证明circLtrB平台中高效的circRNA形成独立于延长的外显子配对相互作用。使用该系统，我们生成了一系列编码序列长度的circRNA，突出了其载荷灵活性。为优化翻译，我们评估了多个内部核糖体进入

extra.description: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) have emerged as promising platforms for stable RNA expression and therapeutic applications, but methods for their generation remain limited. Here, we engineered the Lactococcus lactis LtrB group II intron into a permuted intron-exon (PIE) configuration to enable efficient circRNA formation (circLtrB). Among the tested split designs, LtrB domain IV cleavage yielded the highest circularization efficiency. Although LtrB encodes LtrA maturase required for efficient in vivo splicing, in vitro application of LtrA to the PIE constructs resulted in lower circularization efficiency than self-splicing conditions. We further examined circularization under distinct salt conditions and showed that NH4Cl- and KCl-based splicing buffers independently support high circularization efficiencies (>80%), while producing distinct splicing intermediates, indicating ion-specific mechanistic effects on circularization. Extending outer homology arms did not enhance circularization efficiency, demonstrating that efficient circRNA formation in the circLtrB platform is independent of extended exon pairing interactions. Using this system, we generated circRNAs across a range of coding sequence lengths, highlighting its payload flexibility. To optimize translation, we evaluated multiple internal ribosome entry sites (IRES), including Aichivirus, Crohivirus, CVB3, improved EMCV, HRV, and Salivirus, and found that the CVB3 IRES drove the highest translation efficiency. Linear NLuc showed faster decay kinetics, while circLtrB-NLuc exhibited more sustained expression over time. Transcriptome-wide RNA sequencing revealed comparable innate immune responses between circular and linear RNAs. Together, these results establish circLtrB as a versatile and efficient platform for circRNA production, providing mechanistic insight into group II intron-mediated circularization and expanding the toolkit for functional circRNA engineering.

items.title: Novel retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor gamma inverse agonist enhances checkpoint blockade in hepatocellular carcinoma: a preclinical mouse study
items.title_zh: 新型视黄酸受体相关孤儿受体γ反向激动剂增强肝细胞癌中的检查点阻断：一项临床前小鼠研究
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：中性粒细胞相关炎症与肝细胞癌（HCC）的不良预后相关，但中性粒细胞募集和检查点反应的肿瘤内在调节因子仍不清楚。我们评估了抑制视黄酸受体相关孤儿受体γ（RORgamma）是否改变中性粒细胞募集、程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）表达以及对PD-L1阻断的反应。方法与结果：在癌症基因组图谱HCC队列中分析生存关联。在RORC沉默或TF-S10处理后评估中性粒细胞向HCC细胞的迁移和PD-L1表达。携带原位Hep-55.1c肿瘤的免疫 competent 小鼠接受载体、TF-S10、抗PD-L1或联合治疗。较高的S100A9和CXCL8表达与较短生存相关（分别为P = 0.000459和P = 0.0004413），荷瘤小鼠具有更高的中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比率（P < 0.0001）。RORgamma靶向在体外减少中性粒细胞迁移和瘤内Ly6G+浸润，同时增加肿瘤细胞PD-L1表达。联合治疗

extra.description: Background and Aims: Neutrophil-associated inflammation is associated with poor outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but tumour-intrinsic regulators of neutrophil recruitment and checkpoint response remain unclear. We evaluated whether inhibiting retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor gamma (RORgamma) alters neutrophil recruitment, programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression, and response to PD-L1 blockade. Approach and Results: Survival associations were analysed in The Cancer Genome Atlas HCC cohort. Neutrophil migration toward HCC cells and PD-L1 expression were assessed after RORC silencing or TF-S10 treatment. Immunocompetent mice bearing orthotopic Hep-55.1c tumours received vehicle, TF-S10, anti-PD-L1, or combination treatment. Higher S100A9 and CXCL8 expression was associated with shorter survival (P = 0.000459 and P = 0.0004413, respectively), and tumour-bearing mice had higher neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratios (P < 0.0001). RORgamma targeting reduced neutrophil migration and intratumoural Ly6G+; infiltration while increasing tumour-cell PD-L1 expression in vitro. Combination treatment reduced endpoint liver tumour volume versus anti-PD-L1 monotherapy (P < 0.01). Half of combination-treated mice had tumour volumes less than or equal to 0.10 cm^3 and none exceeded 1.00 cm^3, compared with 62% of controls exceeding 1.00 cm^3. Histologically, 85% of combination-treated mice had less than or equal to 10% liver tumour involvement, versus no controls. Combination treatment also reduced tumour-associated neutrophil populations and peripheral neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratios. All active treatments reduced pulmonary metastatic burden versus controls, without significant differences among treatment groups; 53% of combination-treated mice had no detectable lung metastases. Conclusions: RORgamma inhibition reduces neutrophil recruitment and increases tumour-cell PD-L1 expression. Combined RORgamma inhibition and PD-L1 blockade improves hepatic tumour control in preclinical HCC and warrants further investigation.
